risks.note: The Company states it is mainly exposed to market risks in the form of reduction in value of its investments and a fall in return due to a dip in the investee company's performance - the dominant exposure for a single-segment investment company.
Delay in repayment by the borrower companies can affect liquidity and redeployment scope, per the MD&A Risks and Concerns section.
risks.risk: Borrower repayment delay and liquidity risk

risks.note: The Company states it is exposed to fluctuation of economy and industry cycle; growth momentum is described as largely dependent on ongoing global events that pose downside risk.

The Company operates in a single segment - to invest, deal etc. in securities - with income concentrated in dividends, interest on loans, rental income, fixed deposits and profit on sale of investments, leaving no operating diversification at the standalone level.
risks.risk: Business concentration in a single segment

risks.note: High volatility in the market along with higher inflation has intensified the competition, per the Opportunities and Threats section.
risks.risk: Competitive intensity from market volatility and inflation

risks.note: Climate change reduces both tea yield and quality, and changes in weather patterns affect the timing of the tea flushes, making production less predictable; changing climate patterns interfere with plucking, pruning and applying chemical inputs. Yield depends on weather, irrigation facilities and soil management as the area under plantation is constant.
risks.risk: Climate and weather risk in the tea business

risks.note: Main challenges for the Indian tea industry include rising cost of wages, fertilizers, chemicals, power and fuel, transportation and packaging, labour shortages and import competition; input cost movements in tea and coffee continue to influence sector margins and pricing actions.
risks.risk: Tea input-cost inflation, labour shortage and import competition

risks.note: RBI has projected GDP growth to moderate to approximately 6.6% in FY 2026-27 reflecting downside risks from the geopolitical situation in the Middle East and the possibility of a below-normal monsoon; disruptions in availability of fuel or packaging material due to geopolitical events are being monitored, having been managed so far without affecting manufacturing and supply operations.
risks.risk: Geopolitical disruption to macro conditions and supply
